source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: If you refuse to be tested for driving under the influence you can lose your driving privilege for ninety to seven hundred thirty days or until you reach age twenty one whichever is longer.
corrections.note: Removed comparison to conviction range that is not on the cited page.

corrections.corrected_statement: A driving under the influence conviction can include suspension of driving privileges for ninety days to four years.
corrections.note: Removed comparison to refusal range that is not on the cited page.

corrections.corrected_statement: A minor who receives an alcohol drug or firearm offense runs the risk of delaying licensure until age seventeen.
corrections.note: Removed comparison to under twenty one limits not on the cited page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Before entering an intersection, stop and yield to pedestrians and traffic in the intersection, look in each direction multiple times, and check your side mirrors and over your shoulder for a cyclist, motorcyclist, or pedestrian coming into your path.
corrections.note: Added the required stop before yielding.

corrections.corrected_statement: Yellow lines separate traffic traveling in opposite directions and white lines separate traffic traveling in the same direction.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported claim that color must be answered before line style.

corrections.corrected_statement: Teens must complete at least forty hours of day driving and ten hours of night driving with a licensed driver who has three or more years of experience.
corrections.note: Removed adult-route comparison not stated on this page.

corrections.corrected_statement: On the adult permit route you get a permit after the knowledge exam and practice with a licensed driver who has five or more years of experience before the skills exam.
corrections.note: Removed teen comparison not stated on this page.

corrections.corrected_statement: An agricultural permit allows farm-work driving in a set area with no minimum age, but unlike the instruction permit it does not count toward a first license.
corrections.note: Full relation to first license is stated on page 30, not page 29.

corrections.corrected_statement: An antilock brake system lets you keep steering control during emergency braking but does not shorten stopping distance.
corrections.note: Removed follow-closely claim not stated on page.

corrections.corrected_statement: One-hand steering with the hand at 12 is recommended only when backing, which differs from the 9 and 3 or 10 and 2 positions used for forward driving.
corrections.note: Forward hand positions are stated on page 57, not page 58.

corrections.corrected_statement: Pitch shifts weight front to back, so acceleration loads the rear and hard braking loads the front, unlike roll, which shifts weight side to side in turns.
corrections.note: Roll side-to-side description is stated on page 61, not page 60.
